gnar:
n. A knot or gnarl in wood; hence, a tough, thickset man; --
written also gnarr.
gnarl:
n. 木節, 木瘤
vi. 形成木節, 咆哮
vt. 扭曲
v. twist into a state of deformity
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 2 義為英格蘭方言</dd><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">可能為 gnar 的反覆動詞</dd></dl>
gnarled: a. 多節的, 扭曲的, 多瘤的, 粗糙的, 乖僻的, 乖戾的
s. used of old persons or old trees; covered with knobs or knots

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，形容樹木或年老者的手指、手</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1600-1700 源自 knurled「表面有凸起線條的」，再源自 knurl「突出的小部分」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a gnarled branch；gnarled hands；an ancient gnarled tree</dd></dl>
gnarly: a. 多瘤的, 粗糙的
s used of old persons or old trees; covered with knobs or knots
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性；「極好的」之類用法偏俚語</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>gnarly branches；a gnarly situation；a gnarly accident</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">本義是樹枝等「扭曲多節的」；俚語義的褒貶要看上下文</dd></dl>
gnash:
v. 咬牙切齒
n. 咬
gnashing:
v. 氣得咬牙（gnash的ing形式）
n. 氣得咬牙
gnat:
n. 小昆蟲, 蚊子, 小煩擾
[醫] 蚊, 蚋

n. any of various small biting flies: midges; biting midges; black flies; sand flies
n. (British usage) mosquito
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，指叮人的小飛蟲</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古英語 gnætt，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd></dl>
gnatcatcher: n. very small North American and South American warblers
gnathic:
a. 顎的, 頜的
[醫] 頜的
a. Of or pertaining to the jaw.
gnaw: v. 咬, 啃, 侵蝕, 消耗, 折磨
v. bite or chew on with the teeth

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古英語 gnagan，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>gnaw at sb；gnaw on a bone；gnaw a hole</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">g 不發音；gnaw at sb 可指煩惱或憂慮不斷困擾某人</dd></dl>
gnawing:
n. 咬, 不斷的苦痛
a. 咬的, 令人苦惱的

v bite or chew on with the teeth
v become ground down or deteriorate
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，多用於形容持續的不安或痛苦</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>gnawing doubts；a gnawing suspicion</dd></dl>
gneiss:
n. 片麻岩
[化] 片麻岩
n. a laminated metamorphic rock similar to granite
gnocchi: [復]n.(麵粉或馬鈴薯做的)湯糰,糰子
n. (Italian) a small dumpling made of potato or flour or semolina that is boiled or baked and is usually served with a sauce or with grated cheese
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，義大利菜名的借詞</dd></dl>
gnome: n. 格言, 箴言, 侏儒, 土地神

n. a legendary creature resembling a tiny old man; lives in the depths of the earth and guards buried treasure
n. a short pithy saying expressing a general truth
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，多見於童話與花園裝飾</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>近代拉丁 gnomus，經法語進入英語</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>gnomic (形容詞)</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a garden gnome</dd></dl>
gnomic: a. 格言的, 含格言的
a. relating to or containing gnomes
gnomon: n. indicator provided by the stationary arm whose shadow indicates the time on the sundial
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 5 義為古語；第 6 義為已廢用</dd><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">拉丁語，源自希臘語 gnōmōn（解釋者、辨別者、日晷指針、木工角尺），源自 gignōskein（知曉）——另見 know</dd></dl>
gnosis: n. intuitive knowledge of spiritual truths; said to have been possessed by ancient Gnostics
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">希臘語 gnōsis，字面意為“知識”，源自 gignōskein（知曉）</dd></dl>
gnostic:
n. an advocate of Gnosticism
a. of or relating to Gnosticism
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">後期拉丁語 gnosticus，源自希臘語 gnōstikos（形容詞）</dd></dl>
gnotobiotic: a. [生]限菌動物的,無菌動物的, ( 動物或其環境)限菌的,無菌的
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">希臘語 gnōtos（已知的，源自 gignōskein 知曉）＋英語 biotic——另見 know</dd></dl>
gnu: n. large African antelope having a head with horns like an ox and a long tufted tail
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">開頭的 g 不發音，念作 /nuː/；與軟體專案名 GNU 同形</dd></dl>
